name: In Fear of Death world spawns in Tarren Mill keep their own guids and gossip credit (#12765, #12770, #12750)
contract: Issues #12765 and #12770 report no credit from the Tarren Mill tower mages of quest 1377. The Hillsbrad restore
(rev_20261027_84) and the Defias Tower spawns (rev_20261103_00) both used creature guids 9950700-9950729: in
filename order the Defias replaced the 30 Hillsbrad spawns, in arrival order the Hillsbrad NPCs took the Defias
per-guid SmartAI, which replaces their entry GOSSIP_HELLO credit. rev_20261119_12765 moves the Hillsbrad spawns to
9951000-9951029 at the positions #9583 placed. Asteria 9951015, Morninglare 9951017, Lestern 9951018, Krenna 9951019
and Vorman 9951020 must load at those positions (0.5 yd), Defias Looter 9950717 and Trapper 9950720 must stay at
the Westfall tower, and talking to each world-spawned mage while 1377 is taken must credit its own objective
